---
title: "Registration"
---

Registration is open until March 19 (one week before the Summit), or until we sell out.

#### Regular Pricing

Early registration features a 20% discount and is available until February 1, or until we sell out.

Early registration (up to February 1): $160

Late registration (after February 1): $200

#### Student Pricing (with valid student ID)

Student-priced registrations are limited, so students are encouraged not to delay registration.

Early registration (up to February 1): $80

Late registration (after February 1): $100

### Refund Policy

- Until 28 days before the Summit, you may request a cancellation for a full refund (less processing fees).
- Until 14 days before the Summit, you may request a cancellation for a 50% refund.
- After 14 days in advance of the Summit, we will not honor refund requests.

To request a cancellation of your registration, please [contact](/about#contact) us.
